Security

Report a vulnerability.

If you find a security issue in Zenith Tokens or this website, please tell us privately first.

Report on Telegram →

Policy

ScopeHow to reportOur commitments

Scope

tokens.aitist.ai (the Zenith Tokens console and API) and this website.

How to report

  • Message @hokeemDeng on Telegram with a description, the affected URL or endpoint, steps to reproduce and the impact you observed.
  • Please do not access other users' data, degrade the service or run automated scans at high volume.
  • Give us reasonable time to fix the issue before any public disclosure.

Our commitments

We will acknowledge your report, keep you updated while we investigate, and credit you publicly once the issue is fixed if you would like us to.
